title: Dimension balance for the geometrically regular p-root comparison
statement: Let k be a field of prime characteristic p, A a Noetherian local k-algebra [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] geometrically regular over k [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], and a : Fin n → k such that (d a_i) is k-linearly independent in Omega[k/F_p] [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. Give A its composite F_p-algebra structure through k. Let B = A[X_i]/(X_i^p-algebraMap(a_i)) be the actual p-root quotient [lem-weil-pbc-pth-root-algebra-local]. For every local instance on B making A → B local, put L = B/m_B and beta = Algebra.residueDifferentialComparison p A B [lem-weil-pbc-pth-root-residue-differentials]. Then finrank_L(ker beta) = finrank_L(coker beta). The whole absolute differential modules need not be finite dimensional.

source.place: Tag 07E5, proof of (2) => (4); read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07E5 because the local literature checkout is absent. The big conormal diagram and its snake sequence; original node steps 1-3 and 5-7.

proof.text: Apply pthRoot_cotangent_dimension to obtain finiteness of L/K and equality of the scalar-extended lower and upper cotangent dimensions. The upper quotient is Noetherian by the finite-variable polynomial and quotient instances.

Apply residue_conormal_snake_sequence to the given local map. Cartier equality for the finite residue extension supplies finite H1(L/K) and Omega[L/K] of equal dimensions. The conormal spaces are finite because the local rings are Noetherian. Exactness then makes the kernel and cokernel of beta finite: restrict the kernel-to-H1 map to its range for the former, and use the final surjection for the latter.

Rank-nullity and the cotangent dimension equality make ker alpha and coker alpha have equal finranks. Apply Mathlib Module.sum_neg_one_pow_finrank_eq_zero_of_exact_six to the five snake maps. Cancel the alpha dimensions and the equal H1/Omega dimensions, obtaining finrank ker beta = finrank coker beta.

theorem pthRoot_residue_dimension_balance
    (k : Type u) (A : Type v) [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p]
    (hA : IsGeometricallyRegular k A) (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → k) :
    letI := ZMod.algebra k p
    letI := ((algebraMap k A).comp (algebraMap (ZMod p) k)).toAlgebra
    let B := pthRootAlgebra p n A (fun i ↦ algebraMap k A (a i))
    ∀ [IsLocalRing B] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B)],
    LinearIndependent k (fun i ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D (ZMod p) k (a i)) →
    let L := IsLocalRing.ResidueField B
    let β := residueDifferentialComparison p A B
    Module.finrank L β.ker =
      Module.finrank L ((L ⊗[B] KaehlerDifferential (ZMod p) B) ⧸ β.range)
